title: Container Bookings: free allowance for a late shipping-instruction entry
content:
## Rule
For late shipping instructions on a Container Bookings booking, the free allowance is counted on the booking itself: the entry is recorded at 0.00 while the late submissions already recorded on the same booking are fewer than the tier's free late-document allowance and the free allowance is open, and at the tier's late SI fee otherwise. Late submissions recorded on the customer's other bookings do not count.

## Truth table (hypothetical allowance of 1)
| Late submissions already recorded on this booking | Free allowance open | Entry amount |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | yes | 0.00 |
| 1 | yes | the tier's late SI fee |
| 0 | no | the tier's late SI fee |

On a tier whose free late-document allowance is 0, no count is fewer than 0, so every late SI entry is at the tier's late SI fee.

## Points of judgement
**The customer had late documents on three other bookings this year.** They do not count; only late submissions already recorded on this booking are counted.
